transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm seeking help today because I've been struggling a lot with constantly losing important items like my keys, phone, and wallet. It feels like I'm also just extremely forgetful in my daily life, and it's starting to cause a lot of problems for me.

Have these problems with losing things and forgetfulness been present since childhood, or did they start more recently? If they started recently, was there a particular stressor or change in your life around that time?

These issues definitely aren't recent; I've actually struggled with them since I was a kid, well before I was 12 years old. It's been a constant, daily problem for at least a year now, rather than starting from any recent stress or life changes.
Do these attention and forgetfulness problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work or school and at home, and have they caused problems with your performance or responsibilities?

To be honest, I'm not really sure or haven't thought much about whether these problems happen specifically across different settings like work and home. I also haven't really looked into how they impact my performance or responsibilities overall.
Do you often feel excessively worried or on edge about many different things, and does that worry feel hard to control?
No, I don't really feel excessively worried or on edge. I wouldn't say I struggle with that kind of anxiety or have trouble controlling worries.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down or depressed, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
No, I haven't really been feeling down or depressed lately. I also haven't lost interest in the things I usually enjoy doing.
Besides losing things and forgetfulness, do you often have trouble sustaining attention, finishing tasks, following instructions, or staying organized?

I don't really have those specific difficulties with sustaining attention, finishing tasks, or keeping organized. My main struggles are definitely just losing my things and being forgetful in my daily life.
Do you often get easily distracted by things around you, or miss details and make careless mistakes even when you’re trying to pay attention?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really noticed myself getting easily distracted or making careless mistakes in that way.
Can you give me one example of how the forgetfulness or losing things has affected you at home, and one example of how it has affected you at work or school?

At home, I constantly lose my keys and wallet, and I often forget to pay my bills on time. At work, it causes major issues because I've misplaced important documents and completely forgotten about scheduled meetings with my team.
When you were a child, did teachers or family notice similar problems, like being forgetful, losing school materials, or missing assignments?

Yes, absolutely. Back in elementary school, my teachers and parents always complained about me constantly losing my school supplies and homework. I was also really forgetful and would constantly forget to do my chores or complete my assignments on time.
Do you often avoid or put off tasks that require a lot of sustained mental effort, like paperwork, reading, or detailed projects?
I don't think I really have that issue. I haven't noticed myself avoiding tasks that require a lot of mental effort or putting them off.
